name: sparx — Travel Advisory (Luxury)
tagline: A refined template for luxury travel advisories — book consultations online from day one.
description: A refined, editorial travel-advisory site — a deep navy-teal palette, a warm brass accent and an elegant serif display over ivory, with worldly destination photography carrying the page. Installs a working consultation-booking flow: a real menu of consult types (discovery call, custom itineraries, honeymoons, luxury and VIP trips), three travel advisors you book by name with their own hours, and a planning-fee deposit policy. Ships as "Wander & Co. Travel", a luxury bespoke travel studio.
